claims.claim: The Human-facing PRIMARY launch executes native fast-forward-only synchronization before TASK loading and RUN admission, binding the synchronized upstream SHA as RUN base_sha.
When local main is already equal to upstream, synchronization makes no committed or worktree modifications and admission proceeds normally.

Unsafe repository states (dirty worktree, local-ahead, diverged, detached, non-main, missing or ambiguous upstream, fetch/precondition failures) fail deterministically before RUN creation and before Executor invocation without integrating mutation.

Native fast-forward failures execute exactly one integration attempt without retry or recovery mutation and abort before RUN creation or Executor invocation; unchanged safe pre-sync state produces an admission error, while unsafe post-failure state produces an explicit repository-integrity BLOCKED diagnostic.
When synchronization advances kernel source and TASK state, stale pre-sync code rejects admission and control transfers once to synchronized code that loads the canonical TASK and binds its SHA.
REMEDIATION, REPAIR, and candidate correction paths maintain exact-HEAD lineage behavior and do not auto-fast-forward to upstream main.

Native fast-forward integration introduces no hand-built read-tree/update-ref transaction, rollback loop, retry, fallback, merge commit, rebase, reset, stash, force update, automatic conflict resolution, or remote-main mutation.

PRIMARY admission, exactly-one dispatch, Runtime verification, 60/65 timing, interruption terminalization, and TASK-061 deterministic model defaults (including Antigravity gemini-3.8-flash/high) pass operator regression coverage.
